methodHint.lmp: First day of last period + 280 days (Naegele). Adjusted by the difference if your cycle isn't 28 days.
methodHint.conception: Conception (ovulation) day counts as 2w0d. Conception + 266 days.
methodHint.ultrasound: Most accurate if you have an ultrasound dating, especially one taken before 13w6d.
methodHint.ivf: Transfer date + 263 days (day-3 embryo) or + 261 days (day-5 embryo). Most accurate for IVF pregnancies.

u.cycleHint: Longer than 28 days moves the due date later; shorter moves it earlier (20–45).
u.usHint: Enter the GA on your scan report, e.g. '8w3d'.
u.enterDate: Enter a date to calculate your due date.
u.notYet: Based on this date, the pregnancy hasn't started yet.
u.over42: More than 42 weeks have passed. Check the date, or use this for reference only if the baby has arrived.
u.monthNote: Pregnancy months follow the Korean '4 weeks = 1 month' convention (40 weeks = 10 months). Clinics use weeks + days.

timeline.title: Tests & vaccines
timeline.subtitle: Typical timing used in Korean prenatal care, converted to dates from your due date. Confirm your schedule with your care team.

firstVisit.title: Pregnancy confirmation
firstVisit.desc: Ultrasound checks the gestational sac and heartbeat. The confirmation lets you apply for the medical voucher.

nt.title: First-trimester screening (NT)
nt.desc: Nuchal translucency scan + blood test. Only measurable from 11w0d to 13w6d.

quad.title: Second-trimester screening (Quad)
quad.desc: Maternal blood test screening for neural tube defects and chromosomal risk. Results show risk, not a diagnosis.

anatomy.title: Detailed anatomy scan
anatomy.desc: Checks the baby's brain, heart, spine, limbs and other structures.

gdm.title: Gestational diabetes test
gdm.desc: 50 g glucose screen, then a 100 g OGTT if above the cutoff. Anemia is usually rechecked around now.

tdap.title: Tdap (whooping cough) vaccine
tdap.desc: KDCA recommends vaccination at 27–36 weeks so antibodies pass to the newborn.

gbs.title: Group B strep (GBS) test
gbs.desc: Done at some clinics. If positive, antibiotics are given during labor.

fullTerm.title: Full term (37w–41w6d)
fullTerm.desc: Birth in this window is term. 42 weeks and beyond is post-term.

timeline.visitNote: Typical visit interval: every 4 weeks until 28w, every 2 weeks 28–36w, weekly after 36w. High-risk pregnancies may need more visits.

support.title: Korean pregnancy & birth support
support.subtitle: As of 2026. Dates are based on your due date.
support.voucherDesc: Paid to the National Happiness Card: KRW 1M per fetus (since 2024), +KRW 200k in areas lacking delivery care. Usable until 2 years after birth.
support.leaveDesc: Up to {before} days before birth; at least {after} days must remain after birth (Labor Standards Act Art. 74). If born on the due date, ends {end}. A late birth extends the leave.
support.shortDesc: 2 fewer hours a day with no pay cut, within 12 weeks or from 32 weeks (expanded from 36w on 2025-02-23).
support.note: Amounts and eligibility can change. Check Bokjiro, Work24 or NHIS before applying.

size.title: Average baby size at {w} weeks
size.note: Reference values from the BabyCenter fetal chart. Crown-rump length until 20w, crown-heel after, so the number jumps at 21w. Babies vary a lot.

wg.note: IOM (2009). Assumes 0.5–2 kg gain in the first trimester. Asian BMI cutoffs may differ.
wg.twins: IOM provisional guidance for twins: normal weight 17–25 kg, overweight 14–23 kg, obese 11–19 kg (insufficient data for underweight).

methods.title: How it's calculated
items: Last period (LMP): LMP + 280 days, plus/minus (cycle − 28) days.
Conception/ovulation: conception + 266 days (conception = 2w0d).
Ultrasound: scan date + (280 − GA at scan in days). Early scans are most accurate.
IVF: day-5 transfer + 261 days, day-3 transfer + 263 days (ACOG).
Gestational age always counts from due date − 280 days as 0w0d.

facts.title: Good to know
items: Few babies arrive exactly on the due date; birth from 37w0d to 41w6d is term.
If LMP and early ultrasound differ by more than 7 days (5 days before 9w), clinics usually switch to the ultrasound date.
Once set, the due date is usually not changed by later scans.
Trimesters follow ACOG (1st to 13w6d, 2nd 14–27w6d, 3rd from 28w).

faq.q: My clinic gave a different date.
faq.a: Clinics often confirm the due date with an early ultrasound. Choose 'Ultrasound' and enter the GA from your record to match it.
LMP dating is less reliable. Use an ultrasound record or a known ovulation date instead.
Weeks 16–19 under the '4 weeks = 1 month' convention. Use weeks when talking to your clinic.
For a single baby, 45+ of the 90 days must be after birth, so leave can start 44 days before the due date (twins or more: 120 days, 60+ after).

dueDateCalculator.description: Calculate your due date, gestational age and test schedule from your last period, conception, ultrasound or IVF transfer date.

calculation.title: Calculation Method
items: Naegele's Rule: LMP + 280 days (40 weeks)
Ovulation-based: Ovulation + 266 days (38 weeks)
Average pregnancy duration: about 280 days
Actual delivery within ±2 weeks is normal

tips.title: Notes
items: Ultrasound can provide more accurate dating
First pregnancies may go past due date
Delivery between 37-42 weeks is normal range
Regular prenatal checkups are essential

whatIs.title: What is the Due Date Calculator?
whatIs.description: The due date calculator uses Naegele's Rule based on the Last Menstrual Period (LMP) or ovulation date to automatically calculate your estimated due date (EDD). It also shows the current gestational week, trimester periods, and key prenatal checkup milestones — all at a glance. Calculating in advance before your first prenatal visit makes consultations smoother.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Select or type your last menstrual period (LMP) start date using the date picker.
2. Enter your average cycle length (default 28 days) to refine the due date based on ovulation timing.
3. Click Calculate to see your estimated due date, current gestational week, and trimester dates.
4. Save the result as a shareable link or screenshot to bring to your OB/GYN appointment.

items.a: It subtracts 3 months from the LMP start date and adds 7 days, assuming a 280-day (40-week) pregnancy. This is the worldwide standard used by obstetricians.

items.q: Can the actual birth date differ from the estimated one?
items.a: Yes. The due date is a statistical average. Births within ±2 weeks are considered normal. Always confirm with an ultrasound scan at your clinic.

items.q: What if my cycle is irregular?
items.a: Enter your average cycle length, or switch to ovulation date input mode for a more accurate result.
